dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical narrowing of the 2D geometric profile from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Smooth lateral margins with no significant asymmetrical bulges or indentations visible at the water-skin interface.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; uniform high-intensity pixel baseline across the visible dorsal area.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of multiple faint, linear, light-colored rake marks distributed across the mid-dorsal plane; a distinct dark circular disruption is visible at the blowhole site.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A clear longitudinal indentation/shadowing is visible along the central dorsal axis leading toward the posterior terminus.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple healed linear rake marks visible across the central and upper dorsal surfaces.
